name: Flowering broom in yellow 007
prompt: a tough windbent shrub whose trunk kinks hard sideways then turns up, its bare gripping roots clenched around a single small stone at its base, an organic RAGGED IRREGULAR silhouette with leaves and strands trailing off unevenly at the edges and a torn uneven bottom — never a rectangle, never a straight edge, never a filled panel or square sheet, no hard border of any kind — ONLY the plant itself, isolated on a fully transparent background, NO rock, NO cliff, NO stone wall, NO mountain, NO ground, nothing behind it, flowering broom in yellow, half its branches dead, tall, about three times human height, completely unlit, no glow, no light sources, no self-emission

placement.note: ONE SCENERY PIXEL IS ONE PLAYER PIXEL. world_px_height IS the art's own alpha bbox height, so scenery is placed into the world at 1:1 exactly as the avatar is (setScale(1)) and the two share one pixel grid. The CAMERA still zooms the whole scene — that is uniform and correct; what must never happen is scenery being resampled on its own, against the player. world_height_m is what the art reads as beside a 87px character; declared_height_m is what it was once declared to be, and a gap between them means the ART is the wrong size.
